title: How many of the 170k English words do you know?
summary: Vocabowl is an interactive web application that challenges users to test their English vocabulary knowledge against a database of 170,000 English words. The app gamifies vocabulary assessment, allowing users to see how many words they recognize out of a massive corpus.
problem_solved: Provides a fun, self-paced way to measure and discover the extent of one's English vocabulary knowledge.
why_valuable: Creates engagement around vocabulary learning through gamification, helping users understand the scope of English language mastery in an entertaining format.
